producer_build: Pre-existing executable, not rebuilt from the revision for this extraction.
fat_origin: Upstream ix catalog assemble over the retained typing/Nat.ixe, Nat.add.ixe and Quot.lift.ixe bundles, in that order; labels Nat,Nat.add,Quot.lift; toolchains 4.33.1; pins equal source_revision; deps 1:0.
chunk_origin: Consumer test-only wire writer partitions the same addressed bytes by first owner, retains original blobs/presentation sections and applicable hints/main, and records omitted original constants as assumptions. Complete member address lists are supplied separately.
independent_check: The same upstream executable's Rust catalog verify --deep accepts both catalogs with 3 members and 23 union constants. It does not authenticate the full member witness lists or typecheck the union.
consumer_check: Required tests authenticate full sorted member lists against roots/counts, enforce first ownership/disjointness/full coverage, and typecheck every union constant.
